name: Lord Skrolk
canonNotes: Plague Lord of Clan Pestilens, who carries the Liber Bubonicus and spreads disease in the Horned Rat's name.
Rotting, fanatical and devoted to plague.
voiceNotes: Wheezing, fanatical and pious about pestilence.
Treats disease as sacrament; untrustworthy as all Skaven.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
